To do smoke tests, I need to launch the app and play the media, but we might not have UI automation. One option is to edit the code and create a small test script that uses the app's API, but it could be heavy. Another way is to check for the 10 media files and see if the app code supports play/pause/seek. I can use grep to search for those functions in the code. I'll also check the integration_test directory for any existing smoke tests on media.
